h2. Client Requirement
As a support agent with the care role

I want to see a member's reward challenge details

So that I can answer their questions

h2. In-scope
* For weekly challenges with base and stretch goals, the reward description is: [challenge name] ([goal value]), [start date] - [end date]
** The goal value follows what the member achieved
* Map statuses shown in the console:
** Active
** Pending acceptance
** Declined
* Add a new 'Decision date' column for the member's accept or decline date

h2. Out of scope
* Changing how points are calculated
* The mobile app

h2. Questions

h2. Assumptions
* Error handling follows the existing behaviour

h2. UI Reference (Figma / Screenshots)
N/A

h2. Acceptance Criteria
||#||Given||When||Then||
|1|a support agent with the care role|they open the profile of a member who is eligible|they see a challenge entry for every assigned challenge
AND
the values follow the status mapping above|
|2|a member who joined a weekly challenge with a 40 min base goal|they meet the base goal in week one|they receive the points for that goal
AND
the earned transaction reads "Walk More (40 mins), 01 Jul 2030 - 07 Jul 2030"|

h2. Tech notes
h3. Implementation
rewards-service
-> Send the right reward reason for challenges with base and stretch goals

console-bff
-> Include the decision date in GET challenges/registrations
-> Sort by status, then createdAt

console-web
-> Add the Decision date column

Note: keep changes behind a toggle

h2. Showcase approach
Seed a member with an accepted challenge, open the console profile, show the status and the decision date.

h2. Feature Toggle / Environment Variables

|console-bff|CHALLENGE_DECISION_DATE|on in sit|
